payload.title: Production outage: auraedu.co.in ports 80 and 443 time out
payload.body:
## Reproduction (2026-08-03)

- `auraedu.co.in` resolves to `156.67.222.8`.
- TCP connections to both port 80 and port 443 time out from an independent network probe.
- Browser result: `ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT`.
- The timeout occurs before PHP, routing, or application code can execute.

## Investigation

- The repository has validation, PR, merge, and upstream-sync workflows, but no production deployment/recovery workflow and no GitHub deployment records.
- Production is documented as Hostinger shared hosting with `/public_html` and hPanel Git auto-deploy.

## Required recovery

1. In Hostinger hPanel, verify the hosting account is active and the domain is attached to the correct website.
2. Restore/restart Hostinger web service or remove the infrastructure firewall/WAF block on ports 80 and 443.
3. Confirm the site root points to `/public_html` and the deployed revision is `main`.
4. Verify externally with `curl -I https://auraedu.co.in/` returning an HTTP response.

## Acceptance checks

- Ports 80 and 443 accept TCP connections.
- `https://auraedu.co.in/` returns HTTP 200/30x instead of timing out.
- Hostinger deployment state and deployed SHA are recorded in the issue.
